title: selaginella engelmannii var. standleyi
intro: Selaginella engelmannii var. standleyi, commonly known as the "Mexican Firecracker" or "Standley's Spike Moss", is a species of spikemoss in the family Selaginellaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Selaginella engelmannii var. standleyi include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
